rounds.topic: Mathematical Geometry of Discrete Global Grid Systems — Deep Investigation Loop 1
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 1: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of mathematical geometry of discrete global grid systems. Discretizing the Earth requires projecting an icosahedron onto the ellipsoid; H3 projects onto 20 icosahedral faces with hexagon tessellation, while S2 projects onto 6 cube faces with quadtree subdivisions. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: Uniform Neighbor Adjacency: The Hexagonal Advantage — Deep Investigation Loop 2
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 2: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of uniform neighbor adjacency: the hexagonal advantage. Hexagons have exactly 6 equidistant neighbors with identical center-to-center distances; squares in quadtrees have 8 neighbors with two distinct distances (1 vs sqrt(2)), complicating radius searches. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: The 12 Pentagons Constraint in Icosahedral Topology — Deep Investigation Loop 3
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 3: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of the 12 pentagons constraint in icosahedral topology. Euler's polyhedron formula mandates exactly 12 pentagonal cells at icosahedral vertices across all H3 resolutions, requiring special handling for edge-crossing queries. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: S2 Space-Filling Hilbert Curve Mechanics — Deep Investigation Loop 4
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 4: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of s2 space-filling hilbert curve mechanics. Google S2 maps 2D spherical coordinates onto a 1D 64-bit integer Hilbert curve, preserving spatial locality such that proximate points on Earth remain proximate in memory. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: Resolution Hierarchies & Area Scaling Ratios — Deep Investigation Loop 5
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 5: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of resolution hierarchies & area scaling ratios. H3 provides 16 resolutions (res 0: 4.3M km2 to res 15: 0.89 m2) with an area scaling factor of 1/7th per level; S2 provides 31 levels with strict 1/4th quadtree area scaling. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: Bitwise Hexagon Compaction and Inverted Indexes — Deep Investigation Loop 6
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 6: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of bitwise hexagon compaction and inverted indexes. When all 7 child hexagons are active, H3 compacts them into the single parent cell, enabling multi-resolution polygon representation in minimal byte arrays. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: 64-bit Integer Index Encoding Layout — Deep Investigation Loop 7
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 7: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of 64-bit integer index encoding layout. H3 encodes resolution, base cell, and directional child paths into a single 64-bit unsigned integer (uint64), enabling hardware register bitwise operations in Go 1.25. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: Distance and Bearing Calculations on Hexagonal Grids — Deep Investigation Loop 8
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 8: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of distance and bearing calculations on hexagonal grids. H3 grid distance computes the exact integer step count between any two cells in O(1) time without floating-point trigonometric functions. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.

rounds.topic: Production Post-Mortem: Hexagonal Hierarchy Distortion — Deep Investigation Loop 9
rounds.finding: Empirical Round 9: Rigorous benchmarking and architectural validation of production post-mortem: hexagonal hierarchy distortion. Validated under production Go 1.25+ runtime invariants.
